about.label: About the project
about.statement: Our aim is to supply quality bromine to Indian industry and reduce its dependence on imports.
about.body: Hari Hara Serenity Chemical LLP is setting up a plant at Rapar, Kachchh, Gujarat, to recover and purify bromine from bittern, the residual brine left after salt production. Bromine is a key input for the pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flame-retardant, water-treatment and oil-field chemical industries.
